static_findings: SAFE_FUNCS maps pow directly to built-in pow; ast.Call invokes it without MAX_EXPONENT/MAX_BITS check, which exists only in ast.BinOp. Declared preallocation exponent/bit safeguards do not apply to equivalent function form.
safe_eval returns _eval_node without claimed final numeric/finiteness sanitation; variable values are returned without type or bit-length validation.
Caret is rejected as BitXor by generated Python, so the suggested caret bomb tests do not exercise ast.Pow cap.
